youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for the one deciding whether to keep going.

He: Jesus... the shop hasn't made a profit in a year. 🏪
He: Everyone says shut it down. I don't know if I'm hopeful anymore or just stubborn.
Jesus: Stubbornness leans on your own plan. Hope leans on Me. They can look alike for a while. They don't feel alike.
He: But hope doesn't pay rent. I'm scared to keep going and scared to stop.
Jesus: I fill you with joy and peace while you trust Me. Not after the till fills up. The full heart comes first.
Jesus: Abounding hope isn't a full till. It's a full heart while the till is still filling.
What would you keep going for if hope was all you had left?

“Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.”
Romans 15:13 (KJV)

A full heart comes before a full till.
